title.narrative: Integrated Life-Saving WASH, Health, Nutrition, Protection, ESNFI, and Multipurpose Cash Assistance Response for IDP and Host Communities in Moyale Woreda, Somali Region, Ethiopia

description.narrative: ltpgtThis document outlines a critical and comprehensive humanitarian intervention designed to address the acute, life-threatening needs of conflict- and climate-affected populations in Moyale woreda of the Somali Region, Ethiopia. Implemented by Pastoralist Concern (PC), a national non-governmental organization with deep-rooted experience in the region, this project is proposed for funding under the UNOCHA Ethiopia Humanitarian Fund (EHF) 3rd Reserve Allocation, with a revised total budget of $500,000. The project presents an integrated, multi-sectoral approach, combining Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH), Health, Nutrition, Protection, Emergency Shelter and Non-Food Items (ESNFI), and Multipurpose Cash Assistance (MPCA) to deliver a holistic and impactful response.ltbrgtThe target woreda is currently an epicenter of a complex humanitarian crisis, driven by a confluence of recurrent and severe drought, flash floods, and persistent inter-communal conflict over scarce resources. These shocks have triggered significant internal displacement, dismantled traditional pastoralist livelihoods, and severely degraded the coping capacities of both the displaced and their host communities. The result is a dire situation where an estimated [Insert specific number, to be revised based on Moyale-specific data] individuals, predominantly women and children, are facing extreme vulnerability. They lack access to the most basic life-sustaining services, including safe drinking water, essential healthcare, adequate nutrition, basic shelter, and a secure living environment.ltbrgtIn response, this 9-month project will target approximately [Insert specific number, revised downwards based on $500k budget and single woreda scope] of the most vulnerable individuals, including [x] Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) and [y] members of the over-stretched host communities. The core objective is to save lives, alleviate suffering, and uphold human dignity. This will be achieved through a strategically integrated package of interventions. The WASH component will focus on rehabilitating critical water infrastructure and promoting life-saving hygiene practices. The Health component will deploy mobile health and nutrition teams to deliver primary healthcare directly to inaccessible communities. The Nutrition intervention will tackle acute malnutrition through systematic screening and treatment programs. The new ESNFI component will provide critical emergency shelter materials and core relief items to newly displaced families lacking basic protection from the elements. Crucially, a robust Protection component will be mainstreamed across all sectors and will also deliver targeted services... Finally, the introduction of Multipurpose Cash Assistance will provide vulnerable households with flexibility and dignity...ltbrgt...This intervention represents a vital lifeline for the crisis-affected populations of Moyale, offering an integrated solution to a multi-faceted crisis.ltbrgtlt/pgt
